build_VectorQuantize: build a VectorQuantize module with a fixed codebook for quantizing input tensors using factorized and L2-normalized codes
run_VectorQuantize_forward: run VectorQuantize forward pass to quantize a tensor and return quantized output, commitment loss, codebook loss, and indices
build_ResidualVectorQuantize: build a ResidualVectorQuantize module with multiple stacked codebooks for residual vector quantization with optional quantizer dropout
run_ResidualVectorQuantize_forward: run ResidualVectorQuantize forward pass to quantize input using multiple codebooks and return quantized output, codes, latents, and losses
test_ResidualVectorQuantize_from_codes: test ResidualVectorQuantize from_codes method to reconstruct continuous representation from quantized discrete codebook indices
